scope: sections, regions, notes and complex fields
implemented: per-section headers survive the WPS \sectd\sect ordering: the reset is deferred past the following \sect, so a section commits the header/footer and geometry it accumulated instead of losing them; 072 now writes 40 header references (was 1) and the header renders on every section's pages
remaining: 072 is still +34 pages (638 vs 604). The body line pitch now matches the reference (16.1pt = Arimo 1.15em x \sl280/240). The residual is the gap between adjacent heading paragraphs: WPS adds w:before + w:after (line + 18 + 18) while the renderer uses max(pending_after, space_before) (line + 18). A naive max->sum change regressed the calibrated 06-strict-math-display SVG extent and matches_wps_references, so it was reverted; the reconciliation needs w:contextualSpacing (ignored today) and belongs to the shared P5 metrics/layout queue
\chpgn (chapter page number field, 40 occurrences in 072 headers) is still an explicit Loss, so the header text reads 'Ruth (Page )' rather than 'Ruth (Page 2)'
first/even/odd header regions, note placement/numbering, multi-paragraph/nested fields and custom marks are unreviewed

assertions: a `\sectd\sect` pair keeps the header written after the break on the following section
the intro section carries no header; sections 2 and 3 each carry one
all 40 corpus header parts of 072 are referenced (headerReference count 1 -> 40)
